overview_description.description:
Stoïk is a cyber insurance company that integrates cybersecurity software with insurance protection, helping businesses manage their cyber risks effectively. 
Stoïk empowers brokers by offering clients comprehensive insurance policies and protection against cyber risks. Its mission is to equip brokers with the tools to help their clients insure and safeguard against cyber threats.

Stoïk's unique product simplifies the underwriting process using automated tests, replacing traditional questionnaires. It also provides continuous risk prevention through integrated cybersecurity tools and ensures swift, effective incident response with an in-house team of crisis management experts.

product.name: Cyber Insurance
product.description: A cyber insurance policy that provides financial coverage for companies in the event of cyber incidents, including data breaches and ransomware attacks.

product.name: Stoïk Protect
product.description: An online prevention platform that continuously monitors and reduces cyber risk by identifying vulnerabilities and providing security guidance to insured companies.

product.name: Stoïk MDR (Managed Detection and Response)
product.description: A managed cybersecurity service combining endpoint detection and response (EDR) technology with expert monitoring to detect and respond to cyber threats in real time.

identifier.value: Cyber Incident Response and Claims Management

product.name: Cyber Incident Response and Claims Management
product.description: A 24/7 incident response service providing immediate investigation, defense, system restoration, and claims handling for companies affected by cyberattacks.

product.name: Broker Platform and Digital Underwriting
product.description: A digital platform for insurance brokers enabling fast, automated online underwriting, quote generation, and policy management for cyber insurance.
